# The Estée Lauder Companies

> > Global prestige beauty company with 20+ luxury brands including Estée Lauder, Clinique, Origins, DECIEM, Le Labo, and Bumble and bumble across skincare, makeup, fragrance, and hair care.

The Estée Lauder Companies Inc. is a leading multinational manufacturer and marketer of prestige beauty products. The company operates a diverse portfolio of brands, maintains a strong commitment to social impact including women's advancement, and is pursuing its Beauty Reimagined strategic transformation initiative.

## Company Overview & Strategy

- [Introducing Beauty Reimagined](https://www.elcompanies.com/en/who-we-are/introducing-beauty-reimagined): Beauty Reimagined strategic vision and business transformation plan
- [Our Brands](https://www.elcompanies.com/en/our-brands): Complete portfolio of 20+ prestige beauty brands across all categories
- [Executive Officers](https://www.elcompanies.com/en/investors/corporate-governance/executive-officers): Executive leadership team led by CEO Stéphane de La Faverie

## Brand Portfolio

- [Origins](https://www.elcompanies.com/en/our-brands/origins): Origins natural skincare brand powered by plants and proven by science
- [Bumble and bumble](https://www.elcompanies.com/en/our-brands/bumble-and-bumble): Bumble and bumble luxury hair care brand from NYC salon to global brand
- [AERIN Beauty](https://www.elcompanies.com/en/our-brands/aerin-beauty): AERIN Beauty luxury lifestyle brand founded by Aerin Lauder in 2012
- [Balmain Beauty](https://www.elcompanies.com/en/our-brands/balmain-beauty): Balmain Beauty gender-neutral fragrances from fashion heritage brand
- [Lab Series](https://www.elcompanies.com/en/our-brands/lab-series): LAB SERIES science-backed high-performance men's skincare brand

## Social Impact & Innovation

- [Women's Advancement](https://www.elcompanies.com/en/our-impact/social/womens-advancement): Women's advancement initiatives and gender equality programs by ELC
- [Open Innovation](https://www.elcompanies.com/en/openinnovation): Open innovation program for beauty tech partnerships and collaboration
- [The ELC Cares Employee Relief Fund](https://www.elcompanies.com/en/elccaresfund): ELC Cares Fund providing disaster relief and financial aid to employees
